faq_heading: Questions B2B SaaS founders ask about a LinkedIn outreach agent

faqs.q: What is a LinkedIn outreach agent for B2B SaaS?
faqs.a: It is an AI agent that runs your LinkedIn prospecting every day. It finds people who match your ideal customer profile, writes a personal connection note and message for each one, follows up at a human pace, sorts the replies and alerts your founder or sales head on WhatsApp when a buyer is interested.

faqs.q: Is a LinkedIn outreach agent better than hiring an SDR?
faqs.a: For the repetitive part of prospecting, often yes. An agent works every day, does not need ramp time and keeps a steady pace. A human is still best for discovery calls and closing, so most SaaS teams use the agent to fill the calendar and keep their people on the calls.

faqs.q: Will a LinkedIn outreach agent get my account restricted?
faqs.a: Risk comes from spam-style volume and identical templates. Clara AI keeps daily volume modest, writes personal messages and stops the sequence as soon as someone replies, which stays close to how a careful person uses LinkedIn.

faqs.q: How fast can a SaaS company see results?
faqs.a: We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days. Judge the campaign on reach, acceptances, replies from real buyers and booked calls over a full month, not on the first few days.

faqs.q: Who sees the replies and books the demo?
faqs.a: The agent sorts every reply. Interested buyers are sent to you on WhatsApp with the context of the conversation, so your founder or account executive joins a warm thread and books the demo.
